metadata.sourceFile: ARIS 42648, Table 17 and 42648Z/Digital Data/Digital Data/EZ Gamma
metadata.notes: Eleven historical Southeast drillholes surveyed October 18-20, 2024 with Reflex EZ-Gamma for natural gamma radiation over upper hole intervals to refine overburden-bedrock contact interpretation. Gamma curves are visual digitizations from the supplied Survey-IQ JPEG strip logs; original JPEGs are retained in data/ez_gamma_images.
